name: banking77
instructions: What is the intent of this customer message sent to a digital bank's support chat? Choose the single best-matching intent.

criteria.activate_my_card: Customer wants to activate a card they have received, or asks how activation works.
criteria.age_limit: Asks about minimum age to open/use an account (e.g. can my child / a teenager get an account).
criteria.apple_pay_or_google_pay: Asks about using Apple Pay, Google Pay, Apple Watch or a phone wallet, including topping up through them or a top-up via Apple/Google Pay not working.
criteria.atm_support: Asks where ATMs are, which ATMs accept the card, or whether cash can be withdrawn at a given ATM.
criteria.automatic_top_up: Anything about auto top-up (automatic top-ups): enabling, disabling, how it works, and its limits or amounts.
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer: A bank transfer INTO the customer's account (incoming money, a transfer from their own other/UK bank account, or a top-up by transfer) has been made but is not yet showing / doesn't seem to be working, or they want to check it went through, even if they also ask the normal time frame or how long it takes.
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash: A cheque or cash deposit has not shown up in the balance yet.
criteria.beneficiary_not_allowed: Could not add a payee/beneficiary, or the transfer failed because the beneficiary is not allowed.
criteria.cancel_transfer: Wants to cancel or reverse a transfer they made (e.g. sent to wrong account).
criteria.card_about_to_expire: The card is expiring or has expired; asks about getting a replacement for expiry.
criteria.card_acceptance: Asks where the card is accepted, or whether a shop/merchant/country accepts it.
criteria.card_arrival: Ordered card has not arrived yet; asks where it is or how to track it.
criteria.card_delivery_estimate: Asks how long card delivery takes, how the card will be delivered / how they will get it, or whether faster/express delivery is possible (before any delay).
criteria.card_linking: Wants to link/connect a card to the account or app (including a card found again), or link an existing card.
criteria.card_not_working: The card does not work at all / stopped working, in general or in shops, without specifying a declined payment. (If the card fails at an ATM when getting cash, that is declined_cash_withdrawal.)
criteria.card_payment_fee_charged: Was charged a fee, or charged extra, for using the card to pay / make a purchase.
criteria.card_payment_not_recognised: A card payment appears that the customer did not make or does not recognise, or they say a payment on their statement is wrong (not a fee, and not one they call a debit).
criteria.card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate: The exchange rate applied to a card payment (purchase abroad) was wrong.
criteria.cash_withdrawal_charge: Was charged a fee for withdrawing cash, or asks about ATM withdrawal fees.
criteria.cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: A cash withdrawal appears that the customer did not make, or the app shows a cash amount/entry the customer did not make or did not receive.
criteria.change_pin: Wants to change or reset their PIN (not because it is blocked).
criteria.compromised_card: Suspects card details were stolen/compromised or that someone else is using the card (card still in their possession). If they describe a specific cash withdrawal or payment they did not make, use the matching *_not_recognised intent instead, even if they also ask to freeze the card.
criteria.contactless_not_working: Contactless / tap payments are not working.
criteria.country_support: Asks which countries the service/account/cards are available in, whether people living in a given country (or outside the UK) can get an account or card, whether the card can be mailed/sent to a named country or region, or about using the account from/moving to another country.
criteria.declined_cash_withdrawal: An ATM cash withdrawal was declined/refused, or the card will not work at an ATM so the customer cannot get cash.
criteria.declined_transfer: A transfer was declined/rejected by the bank.
criteria.direct_debit_payment_not_recognised: A direct debit, or a charge the customer calls a 'debit' on their statement, is unfamiliar, unauthorised or taken by mistake.
criteria.disposable_card_limits: Asks about limits or restrictions on disposable virtual cards (how many uses, max amounts).
criteria.edit_personal_details: Wants to change personal details: name, address, phone, email, account details.
criteria.exchange_charge: Asks about fees/charges for currency exchange.
criteria.exchange_rate: Asks what exchange rates are used or where rates come from.
criteria.exchange_via_app: Wants to exchange/convert currency in the app, or asks which currencies can be exchanged.
criteria.extra_charge_on_statement: An unexplained extra fee/charge (often small, e.g. £1 or a dollar) appears on the statement, including when it shows as pending. Not when the customer ties the extra charge to using their card for a payment (card_payment_fee_charged).
criteria.failed_transfer: A transfer failed/did not go through (technical failure, returned).
criteria.fiat_currency_support: Asks which (fiat) currencies can be held/used in the account.
criteria.get_disposable_virtual_card: Wants a disposable (single-use) virtual card or asks how to get one.
criteria.get_physical_card: Has ordered/received a card and asks how to get or activate the physical card PIN / where to find the PIN for a new physical card.
criteria.getting_spare_card: Wants an additional/extra/spare card (for self or family).
criteria.getting_virtual_card: Wants a (non-disposable) virtual card, or asks how to get one.
criteria.lost_or_stolen_card: The card is lost or stolen, or the customer just asks how to freeze/block their card (without describing a specific unauthorised transaction).
criteria.lost_or_stolen_phone: The phone was lost or stolen (access to the app lost).
criteria.order_physical_card: Wants to order a physical card, asks how, whether they can choose it, or where (in general) cards can be delivered. (Whether people living in a given country can get a card or the service is country_support.)
criteria.passcode_forgotten: Forgot the app passcode/password or cannot log in because of it.
criteria.pending_card_payment: A card payment or something the customer explicitly calls a 'payment' / purchase is still pending or has not gone through yet, or they ask when it will go through. Not for a generic 'transaction' or transfer taking long, and not for an unexplained charge (that is extra_charge_on_statement even if pending).
criteria.pending_cash_withdrawal: A cash withdrawal is still showing as pending, or the customer did not receive their money and the transaction still shows as in progress.
criteria.pending_top_up: A top-up is still pending, the customer doubts their top-up went through / completed yet (not that it failed or didn't work), or they topped up and cannot see the funds yet (unless they say it was a bank transfer or a deposit, or say the money left their card and disappeared).
criteria.pending_transfer: An outgoing transfer is still pending (not when the customer asks why it has not gone through after days and insists the account details are correct: transfer_not_received_by_recipient). When the customer says the transfer is/was pending, this wins even if they ask how long to wait.
criteria.pin_blocked: The PIN is blocked after too many wrong attempts; wants it unblocked.
criteria.receiving_money: Asks how to receive money / salary into the account, or about incoming payments.
criteria.Refund_not_showing_up: A refund the merchant has already issued/promised has not appeared in the account.
criteria.request_refund: Wants to request a refund for a purchase, or asks how refunds work / how long getting a refund takes (in general, not about a specific refund that has already been issued).
criteria.reverted_card_payment?: A card payment was reverted/returned or cancelled back.
criteria.supported_cards_and_currencies: Asks which cards or currencies are supported (e.g. for top-up or payments), including whether a specific card brand such as American Express can be used to add money.
criteria.top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge: Asks about fees for topping up by bank transfer.
criteria.top_up_by_card_charge: Asks about or was charged fees for topping up by card.
criteria.top_up_by_cash_or_cheque: Wants to top up using cash or a cheque.
criteria.top_up_failed: A top-up failed, was declined, shows an error, or the customer says it didn't work / asks what went wrong with it. If the customer only doubts it went through or completed yet, that is pending_top_up.
criteria.top_up_limits: Asks about maximum/minimum top-up amounts or limits.
criteria.top_up_reverted: A top-up was reverted/cancelled, the topped-up money first appeared in the account and is now gone, or a top-up attempt did not work and the customer does not understand what happened to the money in their account. Only for top-ups (not purchases from a seller).
criteria.topping_up_by_card: General questions about how topping up works: how to top up using a card, the card top-up process, or who can top up the account (e.g. can other people top up my account). Also: the customer tried to top up with their card and the money is gone / disappeared from the card (it never showed up in the account). If the top-up first appeared in the account and later vanished, that is top_up_reverted. Not fees, limits, declined top-ups, or cash/cheque/bank-transfer top-ups.
criteria.transaction_charged_twice: The same transaction was charged twice (duplicate charge).
criteria.transfer_fee_charged: Was charged a fee for a transfer or for banking/moving money abroad, or complains about a fee while saying they expected transfers to be free (even if they also mention a purchase).
criteria.transfer_into_account: Wants to transfer money into their own account (top up by bank transfer) or asks how.
criteria.transfer_not_received_by_recipient: Sent a transfer / transaction that has not arrived or is taking too long: the recipient (a friend, a retailer, another account) has not received it, the customer insists the recipient account number/info is correct, a domestic (in-country) transfer still hasn't gone through after days, or they ask why their transaction is taking so long. This wins even if they also ask how long transfers take.
criteria.transfer_timing: Asks how long a (bank) transfer takes to arrive, including 'I'm waiting for a transfer, how much longer?'. Not for card payments or purchases. If instead they ask WHY their transaction is taking so long, that is transfer_not_received_by_recipient; if they say the transfer has been pending, that is pending_transfer.
criteria.unable_to_verify_identity: Tried to verify identity but it failed or they cannot complete it.
criteria.verify_my_identity: Asks how to verify identity or what documents are needed.
criteria.verify_source_of_funds: Asks about verifying the source of their funds/money, or vague questions about their money itself: where it comes from, where/how they can see their available money, how its origin is checked, or what protects/secures it. Not an unexplained cash entry showing in the app (cash_withdrawal_not_recognised).
criteria.verify_top_up: Asks about verifying a top-up, e.g. the verification code for a card top-up.
criteria.virtual_card_not_working: The virtual card does not work.
criteria.visa_or_mastercard: Asks whether the card is Visa or Mastercard, or says they want/need a card of a specific network (a Visa card, a Mastercard).
criteria.why_verify_identity: Asks why identity verification is needed, or whether they really have to verify who they are.
criteria.wrong_amount_of_cash_received: The ATM dispensed the wrong amount of cash (less than requested).
criteria.wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal: The exchange rate applied to a cash withdrawal abroad was wrong.
